title: Lyria 3.5 brings longer AI-generated music to Gemini and its API
friendlyTitle: Gemini can now make better and longer music tracks
summary: Google released Lyria 3.5 globally in the Gemini app, with controls for genre, vocals or instrumentals and short or longer tracks. The music model is also available through the Gemini API, Google AI Studio, Flow Music and Google Vids.
friendlySummary: Google added its Lyria 3.5 music model to Gemini around the world. People can choose a style, make music with or without singing and create short or longer tracks.
whyItMatters: Music generation is moving from a specialist demo into familiar consumer and workplace tools. Creators can quickly make backing tracks, jingles and drafts, but commercial users should still check rights, disclosure requirements and whether generated material fits their audience.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This can help with draft music, videos, jingles and personal projects. Before publishing or selling the result, check the rules about rights and telling people AI was used.
